title: Indium Ore
pages: Indium Ore and Deepslate Indium Ore generate deep in the Overworld between Y -64 and 48 (veins of size 6, at most one vein per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Indium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: lens collimator. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/indium inputs are accepted.

Smelt or blast Raw Indium into Indium Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Indium into two Indium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.

Indium uses forge:ores/indium, forge:raw_materials/indium and forge:ingots/indium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Indium reaches higher into the Overworld than Rhodium or Rhenium, so the two-grit Crusher route is a worthwhile trade of 1,200 energy per raw ore when fortune is unavailable. The powered Lattice Engraver also engraves 2 forge:ingots/indium into a lantern in 160 ticks at 24 FE/t; lantern grinding returns only iron nuggets, never indium.
